# LOGOS — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 16
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Source:** P.Ryl. 463 + P.Oxy 3525 (Greek fragments) | Coptic/Greek
**Chapter:** 16

---

*[Chapter 16 is drawn from the Greek papyrus fragments. The text is highly fragmentary.]*

**16:1** [P.Ryl. 463:] [...] "...the Good, and the [fullness] of the [All] will be [restored] [...]"

**16:2** [...] And he said to them, "[...] beware that no one [leads you] astray [...]"

**16:3** [...] the Son of Man [...] within you [...] follow [...]

---

*Translator's Note (LOGOS):* The Greek fragments add little beyond what the Coptic already gives us. The *plērōma* ("fullness") in verse 16:1 is a Valentinian technical term — LOGOS notes it but cannot reconstruct its context.
